name: 伴飞科技剑
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready 2D transparent sprite for an anime science-fiction vertical airplane shooter.
Create exactly ONE original hovering escort sword, a complete independent weapon. Horizontal broadside orthographic view, pointed blade tip at LEFT, short grip and pommel at RIGHT. Centered, fully in frame, fills about 85 percent of a wide canvas. Crisp readable silhouette at only 50-65 game pixels long.
Design: a broad tapered leaf-shaped double-edged blade made from ivory-white titanium armor, a dark navy recessed spine channel, one restrained cyan energy slit, two short swept cobalt guard fins, compact dark graphite grip, and a small hexagonal pommel with a tiny amber indicator. Blade about 70% of total length, total silhouette about 3.4 times as long as tall. Hard-surface mechanical construction, large clean facets, smooth stylized volume, polished mobile game weapon rendering, controlled highlights. Soft three-tone shading and thin dark blue outline.
Reference intent: the clear, substantial floating sword silhouette of a casual airplane shooter, redesigned with new blade profile, guard construction and materials for our existing blue-white anime/mecha game. Do not reproduce a specific existing sword, image or six-frame sprite sheet.
Constraints: single sword only; no character, no airplane, no hands, no pedestal, no floor, no cast shadow, no particles, no external aura, no lettering, no border, no UI frame, no watermark, no duplicate weapon, no extra panels. Genuine transparent background with clean alpha; do not bake checkerboard into the image. The cyan slit is a small material detail; preserve solid readable metal surfaces and avoid blown-out bloom.
